summary: Iteration 101 - Universe Monitor Rollout + Freshness Heatmap testing complete. All 13 backend tests passed. Both frontend pages (AdminUniverseMonitorPage, AdminFreshnessHeatmapPage) verified with all UI elements present and working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 101 tested universe monitor rollout orchestrator and freshness heatmap features. All endpoints pass including: 1) POST /api/user/scanner/run returns scanner_perf with rollout_stage + perf counters, 2) GET /api/admin/universe-monitor summary includes queue_depth, stale_blocks, dropped_evaluations, worker_utilization, top_slow_strategies, top_slow_symbols arrays, 3) GET /api/admin/universe-monitor/trends?window=24h|7d|30d returns points, 4) GET /api/admin/universe-monitor/export.csv returns CSV attachment, 5) GET /api/admin/universe-monitor/breakdown returns user_breakdown + regime_breakdown, 6) GET /api/admin/universe-monitor/freshness-heatmap returns items, 7) GET /api/admin/universe-monitor/rollout/status returns current/recommended stage, 8) POST /api/admin/universe-monitor/rollout/recommend returns KPI decision, 9) POST /api/admin/universe-monitor/rollout/approve updates stage. Frontend UI at /admin/universe-monitor shows all panels: metrics grid, rollout orchestrator with KPI buttons, trend summary, top slow panels, breakdown panels, embedded freshness heatmap widget. /admin/freshness-heatmap loads correctly with window selector functioning.

trends_endpoint_24h_7d_30d.notes: All three windows return points array with proper granularity

csv_export.notes: Returns text/csv with attachment disposition, filename universe_monitor_{window}.csv

freshness_heatmap_endpoint.notes: Returns items[] with symbol, timeframe, stale_rate, stale/total, avg_snapshot_age

rollout_approve.notes: Updates stage, returns approved_by and current_stage
